project.name: PN-0001 / 01 Cold Open
project.brief: Establish the overloaded media environment, then isolate one stable signal. The sequence must feel cinematic and premium, not dystopian or chaotic for its own sake.

narration.text: The internet learned how to generate more. More videos. More posts. More feeds. More noise. But more is not the same as meaning. And speed is not the same as trust.

shots.title: Content Flood
shots.prompt: Cinematic widescreen drift through stacked media walls, autoplay tiles and fragmented feeds in deep black-blue space, premium sci-fi streaming aesthetic, restrained neon accents, overload without copyrighted platform branding.

shots.title: Meaning Fracture
shots.prompt: Digital content fragments slow and separate in a dark premium environment while visual noise loses coherence; elegant motion-graphics composition showing more content without more meaning.

shots.title: Stable Signal
shots.prompt: Fragmented media dissolves into a clean dark void while a single cyan-violet signal line remains stable and luminous in the center, quiet transition from chaos to clarity.

project.name: PN-0001 / 02 Trust Question
project.brief: Move from speed and verification pressure into the central Parallax question: what if trust is built into the media itself? Keep the visual language calm, precise, and human-readable.

narration.text: We are entering a world where media can be created faster than people can verify it. Parallax Network begins with a different question: What would media look like if trust was built into the content itself?

shots.title: Acceleration
shots.prompt: Elegant abstract media streams accelerate past a calm observer frame, clean dark UI space, visual metaphor for creation speed outpacing verification without fear-based imagery.

shots.title: Verification Gap
shots.prompt: A refined split composition: rapidly multiplying media tiles on one side and a deliberate verification trail on the other, restrained cyan and violet light, premium product-film aesthetic.

shots.title: Trust Built In
shots.prompt: A single media frame gains a transparent receipt-like trust layer as structured metadata geometry forms around it, luminous but grounded, clarity replacing uncertainty.

project.name: PN-0001 / 03 Network Reveal
project.brief: Reveal Parallax Network as an AI-native, mission-aligned streaming and creator-swarm platform. Show the product identity and living receipt layer without implying the unfinished platform is already broadly launched.

narration.text: This is Parallax Network. An AI-native streaming and creator-swarm platform for mission-aligned media. Episodes are produced, reviewed, and connected to a living content receipt.

shots.title: Signal Architecture
shots.prompt: A luminous signal line expands from darkness into elegant structured network geometry, cinematic cosmic atmosphere, dark premium brand reveal, precise and calm.

shots.title: Network Interface
shots.prompt: Parallax Network identity resolves into a premium streaming interface with mission channel cards and episode tiles, dark high-trust UI, rich contrast, no false live-service indicators.

shots.title: Living Receipt Layer
shots.prompt: A transparent content receipt panel connects visibly to an episode card, showing AI disclosure, review, rights and version cues in a beautiful understandable certificate-like interface.

project.name: PN-0001 / 04 Production Spine
project.brief: Show a coordinated creator swarm as an accountable production spine: showrunner, research, script, visual, editor and receipt roles. End on visible human authority rather than autonomous self-release.

narration.text: Behind each episode is a visible production spine: showrunner, research, script, visual, editor, and receipt agents. Human operators still make the final calls.

shots.title: Swarm Roles
shots.prompt: Cinematic dashboard with six elegant modular production nodes labeled by role concept: showrunner, research, script, visual, editor and receipt, clean connected workflow, dark premium UI.

shots.title: Production Graph
shots.prompt: Transparent production graph advances through task states, candidate assets and review gates; orchestration rather than automation chaos, visible lineage and version edges.

shots.title: Human Gate
shots.prompt: Warm human operator centered in a calm creative cockpit with Accept, Revise and Reject review gates visible around the work, stewardship and responsibility, not surveillance.

project.name: PN-0001 / 05 Trust Layer
project.brief: Make the Living Content Receipt concrete and understandable. Highlight AI use, claims, rights, human review and change history without implying cryptographic verification has shipped where it has not.

narration.text: Every serious piece of content should be able to answer simple questions: Was AI used? What claims are being made? Were rights checked? Who reviewed it? What changed?

shots.title: Receipt Appears
shots.prompt: Close-up premium Living Content Receipt interface appears beside a media frame, high-trust dark UI with readable structured sections and restrained glow.

shots.title: Five Questions
shots.prompt: Receipt sections illuminate sequentially for AI disclosure, claim posture, rights status, human review and version history, quiet verification feeling, no fake cryptographic success badges.

shots.title: Change History
shots.prompt: A clean version history and change log expands beneath the content receipt, showing transparent evolution of a media artifact and its review state.

project.name: PN-0001 / 06 Mission + Close
project.brief: Close on the human purpose of the network: media that can teach, heal, reveal, organize and inspire, with AI amplifying responsibility. Reveal mission-aligned channels, human guidance and the final Endless aligned signal brand line.

narration.text: Parallax Network is for people who still believe media can teach, heal, reveal, organize, and inspire. It is for a future where AI amplifies responsibility instead of confusion. This is not infinite slop. This is endless aligned signal. Welcome to Parallax Network.

shots.title: Mission Channels
shots.prompt: Premium streaming homepage glides across Parallax Originals, TruthLedger Docs, LumenBridge Network and Virtual Creator Lab channel tiles, cinematic depth and possibility.

shots.title: Human Guided
shots.prompt: A warm human operator remains visible at the center of transparent AI production tools and review gates, calm stewardship and dignity, human-guided AI-native media.

shots.title: Aligned Signal
shots.prompt: Breathtaking closing shot: luminous Parallax signal expands outward into dark cosmic space connecting creators, content and communities, premium hopeful brand finish, Endless aligned signal.
